Plot Method for RiskMap_simulated_surface Objects

Source: R/spatial_prediction.R
plot.RiskMap_simulated_surface.Rd

Maps the linear predictor of a surface extracted with simulated_surface() over its prediction grid.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_simulated_surface'
plot(x, palette = "viridis", reverse_palette = FALSE, limits = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

Output from simulated_surface().

palette

Either the name of a palette from grDevices::hcl.pals() (e.g. "viridis", "Blues", "Spectral") or a character vector of two or more colours to interpolate between. Defaults to "viridis".

reverse_palette

Logical; if TRUE, reverse the order of the palette colours. Defaults to FALSE.

limits

NULL (the default) or a numeric vector of length two giving the range of the colour scale, for example to map several simulations on a common scale.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(), e.g. name or breaks.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The returned object can be modified further with standard ggplot2 functions.

See also

simulated_surface(), plot.RiskMap_simulation()
